sara: Quick sync - postmortem follow-up for GPU capacity. Need owners for 3 small items: quota guardrails, scheduler tuning, headroom runbook + alerts. Keep it tight.

miguel: Ill do quota guardrails (per-customer burst caps + 5m credit bucket). Proposal by Tue EOD.

kevin: Scheduler tuning on me. I'll test memory-weighted bin-packing + restrict group preemption to preemptible pools. Results by Thu.

ashley: I'll write a concise headroom runbook (20%/10%/5% actions) and include auto-rollout block for <25% spare. Draft by Fri.

dmitri: Ops-bot will post daily spare_gpu snapshots and create REM ticket if spare_gpus < 15% for two checks. I'll prototype alert and ticket creation by next Mon.

sara: Great. I'll open REM tickets and schedule a weekly check-in until these are closed. ops-bot: please set reminder.

ops-bot: reminder-created: "Headroom remediation weekly sync" every Mon 09:30 in #incidents. First run: 1965470000. jira-created: REM-9001 assigned-to: miguel, REM-9002 assigned-to: kevin, REM-9003 assigned-to: ashley.

sara: Thanks — close thread when tickets exist and initial drafts posted.
